diagnostic_boundary: Situation-to-mechanism mappings are editorial retrieval routes, not diagnosis or individualized treatment planning.

mechanisms.label: Prediction testing
mechanisms.description: Turn a prediction into an observable question and update from what happens.

mechanisms.label: Actionable problem vs hypothetical worry
mechanisms.description: Decide whether more thinking can produce a practical action.

mechanisms.label: Safety behavior and learning
mechanisms.description: Notice non-essential anxiety-protective behavior that may block learning in objectively low-risk situations.

mechanisms.label: Worry postponement
mechanisms.description: Capture a non-urgent worry for a planned review instead of repeatedly reopening it.

mechanisms.label: Rumination disengagement
mechanisms.description: Notice when reflection has stopped producing new information and deliberately return attention.

mechanisms.label: Uncertainty and reassurance
mechanisms.description: In ordinary low-risk situations, test doing one fewer non-essential check or reassurance step.

mechanisms.label: Graded approach
mechanisms.description: Make an avoided but safe action smaller enough to approach and learn from.

mechanisms.label: Flexible standards
mechanisms.description: Define a fit-for-purpose completion rule before perfectionistic checking expands the task.

mechanisms.label: Continuum evaluation
mechanisms.description: Replace all-or-nothing verdicts with a graded description of what worked and what needs revision.

mechanisms.label: Specific self-evaluation
mechanisms.description: Translate identity-level self-criticism into a specific behavior, choice, or skill that can be reviewed.

mechanisms.label: Balanced standards
mechanisms.description: Compare the rule applied to yourself with the rule you would use for another person in the same circumstances.
